stories.title: Sources: Mariota to miss time with MCL sprain
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Marcus Mariota suffered a sprained MCL that is likely to sideline him for the remainder of the preseason, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Ronaldo will 'probably' retire after this season
stories.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has given his clearest indication yet that he could retire from football at the end of the current season, saying it is "probably my last year."

stories.title: Baez hits 3 straight HRs in 'crazy,' historic debut
stories.summary: Cardinals rookie outfielder Joshua Baez set an MLB record with three home runs in the first three plate appearances of his major league career.

stories.title: Red Sox put Yoshida on IL with hamstring strain
stories.summary: The Red Sox placed Masataka Yoshida on the 10-day IL because of a left hamstring strain.

stories.title: McVay: No 'invisible deadline' on Donald decision
stories.summary: Rams coach Sean McVay says he won't put an "invisible deadline" on Aaron Donald to come out of retirement but added that he hopes the former star defensive tackle makes a decision "sooner than later."
